# Recorded ČSÚ responses

`cen0101ht02.csv` is the response of `https://data.csu.gov.cz/api/dotaz/v1/data/vybery/CEN0101HT02?format=CSV`, recorded on 2026-10-10 and trimmed to January 2020 to May 2021: May 2021 was the last month published on 2021-07-01 (the tests' "today"). Line endings are CRLF, as served.
